# Tool Kumar

> Free, private JSON tools that run in the browser. Documents stay on the device and the app works offline after it loads.

## Primary pages

- [JSON viewer and formatter](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/): format, validate, repair, minify, compare and convert JSON.
- [Resource library](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/resources): the site's reference pages and guides.
- [JSON syntax reference](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/resources/json-reference): values, objects, arrays, strings, numbers and common invalid forms, with links to RFC 8259 and ECMA-404.
- [JSON examples](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/resources/json-examples): fictional API, configuration and nested-data examples with downloadable files.
- [Formatting and validation guide](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/blogs/json-formatting-guide): a practical workflow for finding and fixing syntax errors.
- [Origin of JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/blogs/origin-of-json): the history of the format and its standards.
- [About Tool Kumar](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/about): privacy and processing details.

## Dedicated JSON tools

- [All JSON tools](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools): the crawlable index of formatter, validator, conversion and import tools.
- [JSON validator](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-validator): find syntax errors and repair common loose JSON.
- [JSON minifier](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-minifier): remove insignificant whitespace.
- [JSON diff](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-diff): compare two JSON documents.
- [JSON to TypeScript](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-typescript): generate TypeScript declarations.
- [JSON to Zod](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-zod): generate a Zod schema.
- [JSON Schema generator](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-schema-generator): infer a JSON Schema from an example.
- [JSON to Go](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-go): generate Go structs with JSON tags.
- [JSON to Python](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-python): generate Python Pydantic models.
- [JSON to YAML](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-yaml): convert JSON to YAML.
- [YAML to JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/yaml-to-json): import YAML as formatted JSON.
- [JSON to CSV](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-csv): export JSON records to CSV.
- [CSV to JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/csv-to-json): import CSV records as JSON.
- [JSON to XML](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-xml): convert JSON to XML.
- [XML to JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/xml-to-json): import XML as JSON.
- [JSON to Excel](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-excel): export JSON records to XLSX.
- [JWT decoder](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/jwt-decoder): inspect a JWT header and payload without verification.

- [JSON to Dart](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-dart): Null-safe classes with constructors, fromJson and toJson methods.
- [JSON to Kotlin data classes](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-kotlin): kotlinx.serialization @Serializable models with @SerialName mappings.
- [JSON to Swift models](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-swift): Codable structs with CodingKeys and optional properties.
- [JSON to Java](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-java): Java records with nested records and Jackson @JsonProperty mappings.
- [JSON to C# classes](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-csharp): System.Text.Json models with required and nullable properties.
- [JSON to Rust structs](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-rust): serde derives, key renames, Vec fields and Option types.
- [JSON to PHP classes](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-php): PHP 8.1 readonly constructor properties and fromArray methods.
- [JSON to TOML](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-toml): Tables and arrays of tables, with comments for omitted nulls and large integers.
- [TOML to JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/toml-to-json): Local TOML import with tables, scalar values and arrays.
- [Offline JSON formatter](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/offline-json-formatter): Installation, caching, offline verification, storage and updates.
- [Secure JSON formatter](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/secure-json-formatter): Local document processing, Network verification, analytics disclosure and CSP limits.

## JSON error guides

- [JSON errors hub](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors): choose a guide by diagnostic message and root cause.
- [Unexpected token '<' / DOCTYPE is not valid JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/unexpected-token-html): Fix JSON parsing failures caused by HTML responses. Inspect the response status, content type and body before parsing in JavaScript, Python or Go.
- [Unexpected end of JSON input: empty or truncated data](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/unexpected-end-of-json-input): Find and fix empty responses and truncated JSON behind Unexpected end of JSON input, Python Expecting value at char 0 and Go EOF errors.
- ["undefined" or "[object Object]" is not valid JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/undefined-is-not-valid-json): Fix JSON.parse calls that receive undefined or an already-parsed object. Learn when to parse, when to stringify and how to guard missing storage values.
- [Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/single-quotes-unquoted-keys): Fix single-quoted strings and unquoted keys in JSON. Compare exact Python and JavaScript errors and serialize objects without unsafe quote replacement.
- [JSON trailing comma errors in objects and arrays](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/trailing-comma): Remove trailing commas that strict JSON parsers reject. See version-specific JavaScript, Python and .NET messages and generate valid JSON with serializers.
- [JSONDecodeError: Extra data and multiple JSON values](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/extra-data): Fix Python JSONDecodeError: Extra data and JavaScript errors after a JSON value. Distinguish one JSON document from NDJSON and parse each format correctly.
- [Bad control character in string literal in JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/bad-control-character): Fix unescaped newlines, tabs and other control characters inside JSON strings. See exact JavaScript and Python errors and use serializers to escape values.
- [Go JSON: invalid character looking for beginning of value](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/go-invalid-character): Diagnose unexpected prefixes, plain-text errors and byte-order marks in Go JSON input. Check HTTP bodies and use SyntaxError.Offset to locate the bad byte.

## Site facts

- The parser and formatter run in the browser.
- No account is required to use the viewer.
- The app supports tree and table views, search, JSON paths, comparison, conversion and local downloads.
- Share links keep document data in the URL hash; the service does not process the document on a server.
